mcq.q: Which word is pronounced xīngqīsān?
mcq.explanation: 星期三 is pronounced xīngqīsān and means Wednesday.

mcq.q: Which of these is a staple food that gives the body energy?
mcq.explanation: Staple foods such as rice give energy.

mcq.q: What does 错 cuò mean in a true-or-false exercise?
mcq.explanation: 错 is wrong; 对 is right.

mcq.q: Read the pinyin: yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià. What does it mean?
options: The television is in the living room.
There is a bed in the bedroom.
The chair is under the table.
The door is on the left.
mcq.explanation: yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià. is 椅子在桌子下。, which means "The chair is under the table.".

mcq.q: What does 米饭 (mǐfàn) mean?
mcq.explanation: 米饭 (mǐfàn) means cooked rice.

mcq.q: What does 十 (shí) mean?
mcq.explanation: 十 (shí) means ten.

mcq.q: What does 今天星期几? jīntiān xīngqī jǐ? ask?
options: What day of the week is it today?
mcq.explanation: 几 asks which number, so 星期几 asks which day of the week.

mcq.q: What are the three steps of good imitation?
mcq.explanation: Good imitation means listening carefully, repeating, then comparing with the speaker.

mcq.q: Which word is pronounced wòshì?
mcq.explanation: 卧室 is pronounced wòshì and means bedroom.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "younger brother"?
mcq.explanation: 弟弟 (dìdi) means younger brother.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "Today it rains"?
mcq.explanation: 今天 + 下雨.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "On Wednesday I go to school."?
mcq.explanation: 我星期三去学校。 (wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào.) means "On Wednesday I go to school.".

mcq.q: What does 不 (bù) mean?
mcq.explanation: 不 (bù) means not.

mcq.q: What is the full stop in Chinese?
mcq.explanation: The Chinese full stop is a small circle.

mcq.q: What does the apostrophe in nǚ'ér do?
options: It shows where one syllable ends and the next starts
mcq.explanation: The apostrophe separates nǚ and ér.

mcq.q: What does 洪水 (hóngshuǐ) mean?
mcq.explanation: 洪水 (hóngshuǐ) means flood.

mcq.q: What is vocal projection?
options: Sending your voice to the back of the room without shouting
mcq.explanation: Good breathing and an open mouth help you project.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "The fridge is in the kitchen."?
mcq.explanation: 冰箱在厨房。 (bīngxiāng zài chúfáng.) means "The fridge is in the kitchen.".

mcq.q: Read the pinyin: xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng. What does it mean?
options: On Saturday I rest at home.
On Friday, go to the mosque.
On Wednesday I go to school.
mcq.explanation: xīngqītiān, qù jiàotáng. is 星期天,去教堂。, which means "On Sunday, go to church.".

mcq.q: What does the broken telephone game teach?
mcq.explanation: A whispered word can change when a listener misses a sound or tone.

mcq.q: What does 我 (wǒ) mean?
mcq.explanation: 我 (wǒ) means I, me.

mcq.q: Which is the short form of 星期?
mcq.explanation: 周 zhōu means week and is used in 周一 and 周日.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "I like to drink tea."?
mcq.explanation: 我喜欢喝茶。 (wǒ xǐhuan hē chá.) means "I like to drink tea.".

mcq.q: Which sentence means "This is my father."?
mcq.explanation: 这是我爸爸。 (zhè shì wǒ bàba.) means "This is my father.".

mcq.q: Which weather word means "cloud"?
mcq.explanation: 云 is a cloud.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "The television is on the table."?
mcq.explanation: 电视在桌子上。 (diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng.) means "The television is on the table.".

mcq.q: What does 风来了 fēng lái le mean?
mcq.explanation: 风 is wind and 来了 is has come.

mcq.q: A picture shows a father, but the label says 妈妈. Is the pair right or wrong?
mcq.explanation: 妈妈 is mother, not father.

mcq.q: What does 刀 (dāo) mean?
mcq.explanation: 刀 (dāo) means knife.

mcq.q: Fill the blank: 花园在房子____。 (The garden is on the right of the house.)
mcq.explanation: 右边 is the right side.

mcq.q: What does 鸡肉 (jīròu) mean?
mcq.explanation: 鸡肉 (jīròu) means chicken (meat).

mcq.q: How is 你好 nǐ hǎo really said?
mcq.explanation: Two third tones together: the first changes to the second tone.

mcq.q: Which final is written with two dots on top?
mcq.explanation: The lips-rounded sound ee is written ü, with two dots.

mcq.q: Fill the blank: 我____吃香蕉。 (I like to eat bananas.)
mcq.explanation: 喜欢 means to like.

mcq.q: What does 零食 (língshí) mean?
mcq.explanation: 零食 (língshí) means snacks.

mcq.q: What does 弟弟 (dìdi) mean?
mcq.explanation: 弟弟 (dìdi) means younger brother.

mcq.q: What does 晚饭 (wǎnfàn) mean?
mcq.explanation: 晚饭 (wǎnfàn) means dinner.

mcq.q: What does 七 (qī) mean?
mcq.explanation: 七 (qī) means seven.

mcq.q: Which word for a family member has 女 at the start?
mcq.explanation: 女儿 is daughter.

mcq.q: Read the pinyin: wǒ hē chá. What does it mean?
mcq.explanation: wǒ hē chá. is 我喝茶。, which means "I drink tea.".

mcq.q: Which sentence is correct for "The chair is under the table"?
mcq.explanation: thing + 在 + place + 下.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "flat bread"?
mcq.explanation: 饼 (bǐng) means flat bread.

mcq.q: Which two characters share 肉?
mcq.explanation: 牛肉 is beef and 鸡肉 is chicken.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "The television is in the living room."?
mcq.explanation: 电视在客厅。 (diànshì zài kètīng.) means "The television is in the living room.".

mcq.q: How is the sound ü written after the initials j, q and x?
options: As plain u, as in qù
mcq.explanation: After j, q and x the two dots are dropped, but the sound is still ü.

mcq.q: What does 摸 (mō) mean?
mcq.explanation: 摸 (mō) means to touch.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "Today it rains."?
mcq.explanation: 今天下雨。 (jīntiān xià yǔ.) means "Today it rains.".

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "tooth"?
mcq.explanation: 牙 (yá) means tooth.

mcq.q: In reading aloud, what is stress?
options: Saying an important word a little stronger
mcq.explanation: Stress makes key words stand out but does not change the tone.

mcq.q: What does 大家好 dàjiā hǎo mean?
mcq.explanation: 大家 is everybody.

mcq.q: What does 看 (kàn) mean?
mcq.explanation: 看 (kàn) means to look, to see.

mcq.q: Read the pinyin: kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì. What does it mean?
options: The television is on the table.
There is a television in the living room.
The window is above the sofa.
The door is on the left.
mcq.explanation: kètīng lǐ yǒu diànshì. is 客厅里有电视。, which means "There is a television in the living room.".

mcq.q: What does 猫 (māo) mean?
mcq.explanation: 猫 (māo) means cat.

mcq.q: What does 学校 (xuéxiào) mean?
mcq.explanation: 学校 (xuéxiào) means school.

mcq.q: What does 那 (nà) mean?
mcq.explanation: 那 (nà) means that.

mcq.q: What does 什么 (shénme) mean?
mcq.explanation: 什么 (shénme) means what.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "classmates"?
mcq.explanation: 同学们 (tóngxuémen) means classmates.

mcq.q: Which initial is said WITHOUT a puff of air?
mcq.explanation: d is unaspirated. t, k and p are said with a puff of air.

mcq.q: What does 笑 (xiào) mean?
mcq.explanation: 笑 (xiào) means to laugh, to smile.

mcq.q: Where is the garden in 花园在房子右边?
options: On the left of the house
On the right of the house
mcq.explanation: 右边 is the right side.

mcq.q: What does 早上好 (zǎoshang hǎo) mean?
mcq.explanation: 早上好 (zǎoshang hǎo) means good morning.

mcq.q: Read the pinyin: mén zài zuǒbian. What does it mean?
options: The sofa is beside the door.
The television is on the table.
The door is on the left.
There is a bed in the bedroom.
mcq.explanation: mén zài zuǒbian. is 门在左边。, which means "The door is on the left.".

mcq.q: What does 天气 (tiānqì) mean?
mcq.explanation: 天气 (tiānqì) means weather.

mcq.q: What does 蛋糕 (dàngāo) mean?
mcq.explanation: 蛋糕 (dàngāo) means cake.

mcq.q: What does 厨房 (chúfáng) mean?
mcq.explanation: 厨房 (chúfáng) means kitchen.

mcq.q: What do we call a word made of two syllables blended together?
mcq.explanation: Dis means two, so a disyllabic word has two syllables.

mcq.q: What does 喝 (hē) mean?
mcq.explanation: 喝 (hē) means to drink.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "I love you."?
mcq.explanation: 我爱你。 (wǒ ài nǐ.) means "I love you.".

mcq.q: In the rhyme 妈妈骑马,马慢,妈妈骂马, what does 骂 mà mean?
mcq.explanation: 骂 is to scold.

mcq.q: Which sentence is in the right order for "We cut the cake"?
mcq.explanation: The order is who, action, thing.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "Happy birthday to you!"?
mcq.explanation: 祝你生日快乐! (zhù nǐ shēngrì kuàilè!) means "Happy birthday to you!".

mcq.q: What does 洗手 (xǐshǒu) mean?
mcq.explanation: 洗手 (xǐshǒu) means to wash hands.

mcq.q: What does 玩 (wán) mean?
mcq.explanation: 玩 (wán) means to play.

mcq.q: Fill the blank: 冰箱____厨房。 (The fridge is in the kitchen.)
mcq.explanation: 在 means is at or is in.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "Today there are clouds."?
mcq.explanation: 今天有云。 (jīntiān yǒu yún.) means "Today there are clouds.".

mcq.q: Which word is pronounced érzi?
mcq.explanation: 儿子 is pronounced érzi and means son.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "ear"?
mcq.explanation: 耳朵 (ěrduo) means ear.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "That is my older brother."?
mcq.explanation: 那是我哥哥。 (nà shì wǒ gēge.) means "That is my older brother.".

mcq.q: Which sentence means "There are five people in my family."?
mcq.explanation: 我家有五口人。 (wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén.) means "There are five people in my family.".

mcq.q: Which character means "big"?
mcq.explanation: 大 dà is big.

mcq.q: Fill the blank: 我星期三____学校。 (On Wednesday I go to school.)
mcq.explanation: 去 means to go.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "to speak"?
mcq.explanation: 说 (shuō) means to speak.

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "is at, is in"?
mcq.explanation: 在 (zài) means is at, is in.

mcq.q: What does 八 (bā) mean?
mcq.explanation: 八 (bā) means eight.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "I have two eyes."?
mcq.explanation: 我有两只眼睛。 (wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.) means "I have two eyes.".

mcq.q: Which is an extreme weather event?
mcq.explanation: 洪水 hóngshuǐ is a flood.

mcq.q: What does 星期六 (xīngqīliù) mean?
mcq.explanation: 星期六 (xīngqīliù) means Saturday.

mcq.q: What does 说 (shuō) mean?
mcq.explanation: 说 (shuō) means to speak.

mcq.q: Read the pinyin: zàijiàn! What does it mean?
mcq.explanation: zàijiàn! is 再见!, which means "Goodbye!".

mcq.q: What is a tongue twister used for?
options: To practise clear and fluent pronunciation
mcq.explanation: Tongue twisters practise hard sounds.

mcq.q: Which sentence means "The sofa is beside the door."?
mcq.explanation: 沙发在门旁边。 (shāfā zài mén pángbiān.) means "The sofa is beside the door.".

mcq.q: Which sentence means "Where is the sofa?"?
mcq.explanation: 沙发在哪儿? (shāfā zài nǎr?) means "Where is the sofa?".

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "where"?
mcq.explanation: 哪儿 (nǎr) means where.

mcq.q: Read the pinyin: zhè shì tàiyáng. What does it mean?
mcq.explanation: zhè shì tàiyáng. is 这是太阳。, which means "This is the sun.".

mcq.q: Which Chinese word means "meat"?
mcq.explanation: 肉 (ròu) means meat.

mcq.q: What does 唱歌 (chànggē) mean?
mcq.explanation: 唱歌 (chànggē) means to sing.

mcq.q: Which is a good active listening habit?
options: Face the speaker and listen for key words
mcq.explanation: Active listeners give the speaker attention and catch the key words.

mcq.q: What does 房子 (fángzi) mean?
mcq.explanation: 房子 (fángzi) means house.

mcq.q: What does 咖啡 (kāfēi) mean?
mcq.explanation: 咖啡 (kāfēi) means coffee.

mcq.q: What does 他们 (tāmen) mean?
mcq.explanation: 他们 (tāmen) means they.
